entities.summary: Sergei Tchoban is a german architect and artist of russian descent. He is managing partner of the architectural firm TCHOBAN VOSS Architekten and founder of the Tchoban Foundation, which has been based in the Museum of Architectural Drawing in Berlin, built specifically for this purpose, since 2013. Tchoban is member of the Association of German Architects (BDA) and the architectural associations in Hamburg and Berlin.
